name: thesis-mcwm-context-control-v10
selection: Frozen v7 coefficients selected only from the other seed's development days. Recognizers fitted only on the other seed's fixed-policy source blocks. No dependency on v8 and no new coefficient selection in this campaign.
interpretation: Independent prospective bus-policy comparison following source-only filter diagnosis. Two reused offline initializer seeds, not independent research confirmation. Compare a fresh fixed-0.25 control, original eight-feature context, three-feature context, and four-block averaged three-feature context with a fixed score-margin fallback. The old context coefficient mapping remains intentionally unchanged, including its cross-seed instability. Source budgets, observed TD scaling, normalized trust, actor mixture and deployment safeguard stay fixed.
